title: Accordion
description: Disclosure built on native <details>. Zero JavaScript, keyboard and find-in-page included.
usage: For FAQs and secondary detail. The first item can start open; the rest stay shut. If content must be findable with Ctrl-F, this is the right primitive — details content is searchable.
a11y: <details>/<summary> is natively focusable and announced as expandable. The chevron is decorative; state comes from the element itself.
